shortDescription: prefix list configuration handling for SONiC

options.name: config
options.description: Specifies a list of prefix set configuration dictionaries

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the type of configuration update to be performed on the device. For "merged", merge specified attributes with existing configured attributes. For "deleted", delete the specified attributes from existing configuration. For "replaced", replace the specified existing configuration with the provided configuration. For "overridden", override the existing configuration with the provided configuration.
